items.stem: An audit firm's partner owns shares in the audit client. Under independence rules this is:

options.text: A prohibited financial interest impairing independence
options.rationale: Correct: a direct financial interest in a client impairs independence.

options.text: Allowed if the shares are small
options.rationale: A direct financial interest impairs independence regardless of size.

options.text: Allowed if disclosed in the report
options.rationale: Disclosure does not cure a prohibited financial interest.

options.text: Only a concern for tax staff
options.rationale: It affects the firm’s independence on the engagement.

items.explanation: Correct: a direct financial interest in a client impairs independence.

items.stem: Which TWO situations typically lead to a modified audit opinion? (Select TWO)

options.text: A material and pervasive misstatement management will not correct
options.rationale: Correct: a material, pervasive misstatement leads to an adverse opinion.

options.text: An inability to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence that is material and pervasive
options.rationale: Correct: a pervasive scope limitation leads to a disclaimer.

options.text: Management provides all requested evidence and records are clean
An immaterial classification error that is corrected
options.rationale: Immaterial, corrected items do not modify the opinion.

items.explanation: Correct: a material, pervasive misstatement leads to an adverse opinion.
